d: Tensions reach their breaking point amongst the Gloucester fleet as captains, mates and vessels fall apart.

t: Wicked Tuna: All Hands On Deck
d: With only four weeks left in the Atlantic Bluefin season, two boats have the challenge of novice fishermen on board – and it could make or break their season.

With only two weeks left on the North Atlantic Bluefin tuna fishing season, just one fish is not enough for the Gloucester captains – and the lure of doubling their luck is overpowering.

t: Wicked Tuna: Money On The Line
d: In the first episode of a two-part season finale, Gloucester's reigning Bluefin champion Dave Carraro, of FV-tuna.com, starts the fishing season with a $20,000 lead over his rival.
